units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 113a:7">B. Mets. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>נַתּוּחֵי אין וכ׳</he> the court messenger may distrain out side of the house, but enter and seize he dare not?

<cite ref="Beitzah 10b:14">Bets. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>גוזלות מְנַתְּחֵי מהדדי</he> (not <he>אהדדי</he>; Ms. M. <he>מנתקי</he>) pigeons might pull against each other (and tear the bands); <cite ref="Gittin 51a">Gitt. 51ᵃ</cite>
